items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Carney Connie used to tell me stories about Duke.

ctx.x: to ever go through all of that again, and he still continued to do it.

Carney Connie used to tell me stories about Duke. They used to drive, and he said Duke wouldn't like for you to talk, you know, he says, because he's getting his ideas together. He said one reason Duke liked for him to go with him because he kept quite, quiet. He didn't like to talk anyway. Carney Connie was quiet, you know. He said -- so, they were a perfect match. And he liked to drive, Connie liked to drive so.
I don't know how he did it
